prices.note: Baggu is a headless store (no products.json). Product cards read from 11 collection pages (bags, shoulder-bags, totes, crescent-bags, reusable-bags, backpacks, crossbody-bags, travel-bags, best-sellers, denim, new-arrivals): 44 bag families, 8 showing two prices (markdown) excluded, Standard Baggu Set of 3 and 2 duffles excluded; 33 regular-price bags, median $58. Low: Baby Baggu $14; Standard Baggu $16; Big Baggu $22; Small/Medium/Large Nylon Crescent Bag $52/$56/$66; Cloud Bag $62; Nylon Shoulder Bag $62; high: Recycled Leather Shoulder Bag $190. Like-for-like: carry bags at regular price, in stock (reusable/shopping bags, totes, shoulder and crossbody bags, belt/hip bags, backpacks); luggage, duffels and weekenders, pouches, organisers, wallets, straps, charms, lunch boxes excluded.

production_model: Made in China, Cambodia and Vietnam
notes: Design and Materials: 'BAGGU began in 2007 making durable reusable shopping bags.' Since Spring 2022 all ripstop nylon styles, including the reusable bags, are 100% recycled nylon; heavyweight nylon 59% recycled; denim and canvas 65% recycled cotton; recycled leather is 70% recycled leather fibres. Reusable bags are cut from one continuous piece of recycled nylon. Manufacturing in Cambodia and Vietnam alongside long-standing partners in China; never incinerates or landfills deadstock (https://baggu.com/design-and-materials).

FAQ: free shipping on US orders over $50; ships to Canada, Australia, the UK and other countries at listed rates; returns on full-price items within 30 days, original shipping non-refundable and a $4.95 restocking fee on most returns (waived for exchanges, store credit and in-store returns); sale items final sale; one-time price adjustment if an item goes on sale within 7 days; 'stocked at hundreds of retailers in the US and internationally'; official sites are baggu.com and baggu.jp (https://baggu.com/faq).

Stores page lists Chicago (Lincoln Park, Wicker Park), New York (SoHo, MoMA Design Store pop-up), Brooklyn (Williamsburg), Los Angeles (Silver Lake, Venice), Portland and San Francisco (https://baggu.com/stores).

Wikipedia: founded 2007 by Emily Sugihara, her mother Joan Hall Sugihara and Ellen Vanderlaan; private company; launched with an $8 reusable shopping bag (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Baggu). HQ city not stated there; hq_country US from its US stores and US store currency.
